name: Kasai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kasai city emblem in green: a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes with wings.
history: Municipal flag of Kasai, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 10 June 1968; the emblem dates from 6 May 1967.

features.role: Kasai city emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes with wings
